overview: The committee reviewed membership vacancies, received municipal energy updates, and discussed tree preservation ordinances, wildfire smoke air quality guidance, and community waste reduction initiatives.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes from the October meeting.

items.title: Committee Membership and Leadership
items.summary: Members discussed recruiting new applicants and seeking an additional co-chair following a member's resignation.

items.title: Electrify Medford and Energy Program Updates
items.summary: Brenda Pike reported on the Mass Save partnership application, lowered electricity aggregation rates with increased renewable content, and a 19% reduction in municipal energy use since 2009.

items.title: Harvest Your Energy Festival Debrief
items.summary: The committee reviewed logistics, strong participation in electronics recycling, and public interest in waste management at the festival.

items.title: Trees Medford Ordinances and Significant Trees Project
items.summary: Lauretta James announced a City Council Committee of the Whole meeting on proposed tree ordinances and outlined a developing landmark tree mapping initiative.

items.title: Outdoor Air Quality Communications
items.summary: The committee discussed preparing public health advisories for wildfire smoke and utilizing PurpleAir monitor data.

items.title: Waste Reduction Initiatives
items.summary: Members discussed waste diversion ideas, including material swaps, repair cafes, specialized recycling options, and consulting Zero Waste Melrose.

items.title: Rodent Control and State Climate Legislation
items.summary: Members discussed rodenticide alternatives and reviewed pending state climate and economic development legislation.
